details: picklescan before 0.0.22 only considers standard pickle file extensions in the scope for its vulnerability scan. An attacker could craft a malicious model that uses Pickle and include a malicious pickle file with a non-standard file extension. Because the malicious pickle file inclusion is not considered as part of the scope of picklescan, the file would pass security checks and appear to be safe, when it could instead prove to be problematic.

A vulnerability in the GraphCypherQAChain class of langchain-ai/langchain-community version 0.2.5 allows for SQL injection through prompt injection. This vulnerability can lead to unauthorized data manipulation, data exfiltration, denial of service (DoS) by deleting all data, breaches in multi-tenant security environments, and data integrity issues. Attackers can create, update, or delete nodes and relationships without proper authorization, extract sensitive data, disrupt services, access data across different tenants, and compromise the integrity of the database.

workarounds.value:
IBM strongly recommends applying the following configuration controls to deployments using MCP stdio in addition to upgrading Langflow OSS to version 1.12.5. These controls do not replace the upgrade.



Set LANGFLOW_MCP_SERVER_INTERPRETER_HARDENING=true to reject direct shell-script execution, and set LANGFLOW_CUSTOM_COMPONENT_ADMIN_ONLY=true to block non-admin MCP stdio access. Restart the Langflow service after updating its environment configuration. These restrictions can require changes to existing MCP server launch configurations and limit which users can use MCP stdio.



For public workflows, retain the default restriction on custom components. Explicitly enabling LANGFLOW_ALLOW_PUBLIC_CUSTOM_COMPONENTS permits custom component execution and changes the default protection described for CVE-2026-18894.



For CVE-2026-77817, upgrading prevents the identified secret disclosure in new flow and project exports. Revoke or rotate any credentials exposed in previously exported files; upgrading does not remove secrets from copies already exported.

solutions.value: Upgrade to Langflow OSS 1.13.0 or later. The latest release is available at  https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow/releases . Users deploying via pip may upgrade with: pip install langflow --upgrade. Users deploying via Docker should pull the latest tagged image.

cna.title: Langflow OSS is affected by multiple vulnerabilities

descriptions.description: CWE-862 Missing Authorization

descriptions.value: IBM Langflow OSS 1.0.0 through 1.12.4 could allow a remote attacker with a low-privileged authenticated account to bypass the administrator-only restriction and execute arbitrary code on the server by configuring a built-in code-execution component with attacker-supplied inputs.

supportingMedia.value: IBM Langflow OSS 1.0.0 through 1.12.4 could allow a remote attacker with a low-privileged authenticated account to bypass the administrator-only restriction and execute arbitrary code on the server by configuring a built-in code-execution component with attacker-supplied inputs.

workarounds.value:
IBM strongly recommends applying the following configuration controls to deployments using MCP stdio in addition to upgrading Langflow OSS to version 1.12.5. These controls do not replace the upgrade.



Set LANGFLOW_MCP_SERVER_INTERPRETER_HARDENING=true to reject direct shell-script execution, and set LANGFLOW_CUSTOM_COMPONENT_ADMIN_ONLY=true to block non-admin MCP stdio access. Restart the Langflow service after updating its environment configuration. These restrictions can require changes to existing MCP server launch configurations and limit which users can use MCP stdio.



For public workflows, retain the default restriction on custom components. Explicitly enabling LANGFLOW_ALLOW_PUBLIC_CUSTOM_COMPONENTS permits custom component execution and changes the default protection described for CVE-2026-18894.



For CVE-2026-77817, upgrading prevents the identified secret disclosure in new flow and project exports. Revoke or rotate any credentials exposed in previously exported files; upgrading does not remove secrets from copies already exported.

solutions.value:
IBM strongly recommends addressing the vulnerability now by upgrading  Langflow OSS to version 1.12.5. https://pypi.org/project/langflow/1.12.5/ 



For Langflow OSS versions 1.0.0 - 1.12.4, follow the  Prepare to upgrade instructions and release-specific configuration changes https://docs.langflow.org/release-notes , including backing up your existing installation, then follow the  Langflow OSS installation instructions https://docs.langflow.org/get-started-installation  to install version 1.12.5 and test your flows. For deployments using MCP stdio, also apply the configuration controls in Workarounds and Mitigations.



This bulletin also discloses fixes delivered in prior releases: CVE-2026-107366 was fixed in version 1.9.0; CVE-2026-18894 was fixed in version 1.11.2; and CVE-2026-77817 was fixed in version 1.11.5. Version 1.12.5 includes these fixes.
